sentences.en: All elections are important. But we know in our bones this one is more consequential.
sentences.zh: 所有的选举都很重要。但我们知道，这次选举的影响更为深远。

sentences.en: The new policy will have consequential changes on the economy.
sentences.zh: 新政策会对经济产生重大的影响。

sentences.en: Choosing the right career path can be quite consequential for your future happiness.
sentences.zh: 选择正确的职业道路对你的未来幸福可能会非常关键。

senses.zh: 重要的；间接的；随之发生的；自高自大的
